easy.def: Something you keep to remember a trip.
examples: She has a souvenir from Paris.

more.def: A small thing that you buy or keep to remind you of a place or a trip.
examples: I bought a souvenir at the museum.
A shell was my souvenir from the beach.
She keeps a souvenir from every trip.
The sovereign lives in a palace.

more.def: A king or queen who rules a country.
examples: The sovereign waved to the crowds from the balcony.
The country was ruled by a wise sovereign.
The crown is worn by the sovereign at special events.

more.def: Having the power to rule itself, with no other country in charge.
examples: The islands became a sovereign nation after many years.
A sovereign country makes its own laws.
The people worked for a sovereign land.
Farmers sow seeds in the spring.

more.def: To plant seeds in the ground by scattering or putting them in rows.
examples: Farmers sow wheat in the fall and harvest it the next summer.
We sowed lettuce seeds in the garden bed.
She sows flower seeds along the fence every spring.
A sow is in the pen.
The sow lay in the mud.

more.def: A fully grown female pig.
examples: The sow nursed her nine piglets in the straw.
The farmer fed the sow in the morning.
A sow can have many piglets at one time.

easy.def: A small bean grown on farms.

more.def: A small bean that grows in pods and is used to make food such as tofu and oil.
